meals.name: Quick Skillet Chicken Fajita Tacos
meals.description: Flavorful chicken and peppers cooked in one skillet, perfect for build-your-own tacos, ready in about 40 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken breasts into thin strips. Thinly slice the yellow onion and bell peppers. Mince the garlic.

Step 2: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or cast-iron pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken strips and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.

Step 3: Add sliced onion and bell peppers to the same skillet, adding a little more olive oil if needed. Sauté for 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant.

Step 4: Return chicken to the skillet with the vegetables. Stir in taco seasoning and chicken broth. Cook for 2-3 minutes, allowing sauce to thicken slightly. Squeeze the juice of one lime over the mixture.
Step 5: Warm tortillas according to package directions. Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture in warm tortillas with shredded cheddar cheese, sour cream, fresh cilantro, and salsa.

meals.name: Speedy Shrimp Fajita Rice Bowls
meals.description: Quick-cooking shrimp and vegetables seasoned with fajita spices, served over rice for a vibrant, flavorful bowl in under 35 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Cook rice according to package directions: Combine 1 cup rice and 2 cups water in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until water is absorbed and rice is tender. Fluff with a fork.
Step 2: While rice cooks, slice bell peppers and red onion into thin strips. Pat shrimp dry.
Step 3: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sliced bell peppers and red onion and sauté for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp.

Step 4: Add shrimp to the skillet with the vegetables and sprinkle with fajita seasoning. Cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are pink and opaque. Squeeze the juice of one lime over the mixture.
Step 5: Divide cooked rice among 4 bowls. Top with shrimp and vegetable mixture. Garnish with sliced avocado and fresh cilantro.

meals.name: Hearty Slow Cooker Pot Roast with Root Vegetables
meals.description: Tender beef chuck roast cooked low and slow with potatoes, carrots, and celery, yielding a comforting family meal.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.amount: 1 lb, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Step 1: Season beef chuck roast generously with salt and pepper. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the roast on all sides until well-browned, about 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer the seared roast to a 6-quart (or larger) slow cooker.
Step 2: Add chopped yellow onion, carrots, celery, and potatoes around the roast in the slow cooker. Sprinkle minced garlic over the vegetables.
Step 3: In a medium bowl, whisk together beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, and tomato paste. Pour the liquid over the roast and vegetables. Add fresh thyme sprigs.
Step 4: Cover the slow cooker and cook on LOW for 6-8 hours or on HIGH for 3-4 hours, until the beef is fork-tender and the vegetables are soft. Remove thyme sprigs before serving.
Step 5: Shred the beef with two forks (it should fall apart easily) and serve with the cooked vegetables and rich broth.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Steak Fajitas with Cilantro-Lime Drizzle
meals.description: Tender steak and vibrant bell peppers roasted together on one sheet pan, offering a quick and flavorful weeknight fajita feast.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Slice steak against the grain into thin strips. Slice bell peppers and red onion into thin strips.

Step 2: In a large bowl, combine steak strips, bell pepper strips, and onion strips. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and sprinkle evenly with fajita seasoning. Toss until everything is well coated.

Step 3: Spread the seasoned steak and vegetables in a single layer on a large sheet pan. Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until steak is cooked to desired doneness and vegetables are tender-crisp.
Step 4: While fajitas roast, prepare toppings. Warm tortillas according to package directions. For a cilantro-lime drizzle, whisk together fresh lime juice and chopped cilantro.
Step 5: Serve the hot steak and vegetable mixture immediately with warm tortillas and your favorite toppings like salsa, sour cream, sliced avocado, and the cilantro-lime drizzle.

meals.name: One-Pan Zesty Sausage and Bell Pepper Pasta
meals.description: A quick and flavorful pasta dish with savory Italian sausage, colorful bell peppers, and diced tomatoes, all cooked in one pan in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: Italian sausage (ground or links, casing removed)

instructions: Step 1: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large, deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add Italian sausage and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess grease.
Step 2: Add sliced bell peppers, chopped yellow onion, and minced garlic to the skillet with the sausage. Sauté for 3-5 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Step 3: Stir in the uncooked penne pasta, undrained diced tomatoes, pasta sauce, and chicken broth. Bring the mixture to a boil.
Step 4: Reduce heat to medium-low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until pasta is al dente and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Step 5: Remove from heat, stir in fresh basil, and let stand for 2 minutes. Serve immediately, topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Crispy Chicken Tenders with Roasted Sweet Potatoes & Honey-Mustard Dip
meals.description: Kid-friendly crispy chicken tenders baked to perfection with roasted sweet potatoes, served with a tangy homemade honey-mustard dipping sauce.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. In a shallow dish, whisk the 2 large eggs. In another shallow dish, combine panko bread crumbs with 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper.

Step 2: Pat chicken tenderloins dry. Dip each tenderloin first into the egg wash, allowing excess to drip off, then dredge in the panko mixture, pressing gently to coat evenly. Place coated tenders on the prepared baking sheet, ensuring they are not touching.

Step 3: In a bowl, toss cubed sweet potatoes with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, remaining 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper. Spread them in a single layer on the same baking sheet alongside the chicken tenders.

Step 4: Bake for 25-30 minutes, flipping chicken and potatoes halfway through, until chicken is golden brown, crispy, and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F / 74°C) and potatoes are tender. For extra crispiness, you can broil for the last 2-3 minutes.

Step 5: While chicken and potatoes bake, prepare the honey-mustard dip: In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, and honey until smooth. Serve the crispy chicken tenders and roasted sweet potatoes with the dipping sauce.

meals.name: Pan-Seared Cod with Lemon-Dill Sauce and Roasted Asparagus
meals.description: Flaky pan-seared cod fillets served with a bright, herbaceous lemon-dill sauce and perfectly roasted asparagus for a light yet satisfying meal.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss trimmed asparagus with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 15-20 minutes, or until tender-crisp.
Step 2: Pat cod fillets dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt and pepper. Slice one lemon into thin rounds, and reserve the other for juicing.

Step 3: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil and 1 tablespoon of butter in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat until butter is melted and shimmering. Carefully place cod fillets in the hot skillet.
Step 4: Sear the cod for 3-5 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until golden brown and flaky. Avoid overcooking. Remove cod from skillet and keep warm.

Step 5: To the same skillet, add remaining 1 tablespoon of butter, minced garlic, and the juice of the remaining lemon. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, then stir in fresh chopped dill and parsley (if using). Spoon the lemon-dill sauce over the pan-seared cod and serve immediately with the roasted asparagus.
